name: C11_PAIR_MULTIPLICITY_FALSE_TWIN_BLOWUP_THEOREM

family.vertices: {s,t,p,m,n,z} union A_r union B_q, A_r={a_1,...,a_r}, B_q={b_1,...,b_q}
edges: for each a in A_r: a-s and a-z
for each b in B_q: b-t, b-m, b-z

target_claims: The old seeded precoloring satisfies frozen axioms (i)-(v) for every r,q.
The stored 111 state is Q-admissible and the normalized/raw constructor yields the stated descendant for every r,q.
G_{r,q} is P7-free for every r,q.
One global extension colors every A_r vertex 3, every B_q vertex 4, and z 1.
Every ordered pair (a_i,b_j) is answer-relevant C11 and R_C11=K_{r,q}.
Therefore |R_C11|=rq with |S|=2 fixed, falsifying universal P1 bounded-pair-family.
Any vertex hitting set for all answer-relevant pairs has size at least min(r,q), falsifying universal P2 bounded-vertex-hitting.
All vertices in A_r union B_q have the same Y0'-component signature { {z} } up to side labels; equal Sigma does not bound pair multiplicity.
This counterfamily does not falsify P3; within this family all pairs are twin/symmetry equivalent and have Pi={3,4}^2.
p7_free_proof_contract: A_r and B_q are independent false-twin modules.
In any induced path on at least four vertices, two distinct nonadjacent vertices cannot have identical open neighborhoods inside the path.
Hence an induced P7 in G_{r,q} contains at most one vertex of A_r and at most one vertex of B_q.
Replacing any selected a_i by y and b_j by y' gives an induced P7 in the canonical H8.
The canonical H8 is P7-free by frozen parent authority, contradiction.
forbidden: claim P3 false or true universally
claim hardness or lower bound beyond P1/P2 definitions
